raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `SGLANG_RUST_SERVER=1`, every DP-group leader embeds a Rust listener on `--port + offset` and `--grpc-port + offset`. The offset counts DP-group leaders inside one TP group's node-local range. Plain DP (`--dp N` without attention DP) runs N separate TP groups, each led by its own TP rank 0, so every replica computes offset 0 and binds the same HTTP and gRPC ports. Plain DP cannot start in Rust mode.

## Modifications

- `RustServer.launch`: under plain DP the listener offset is the replica index (`dp_rank`). Plain DP is single-node (`check_server_args` already rejects multi-node replicas), so every replica's leader is on this node. Attention DP and no-DP keep the existing formula.
- `check_server_args`: Rust-mode PD prefill with plain DP is rejected, since every replica registers its KV bootstrap rows with the `--port` listener.
- Test: the Rust server extension test gets the DP fields `launch` now reads.

## Dependencies

Independent of the other PRs split out of this one (sidecar, attention-DP idle, `node_listeners`). The `node_listeners` PR has a plain-DP test case that needs this PR.

+    # plain DP replicas all register with the --port listener.
+    if (
+        envs.SGLANG_RUST_SERVER.get()

+        and cfg.dp_size > 1

+            f"SGLANG_RUST_SERVER prefill does not support --dp-size {cfg.dp_size} "

+            "--port listener, so the other replicas' listeners advertise "
+            "registries that never become ready. Launch one prefill server per "
+            "replica, or unset SGLANG_RUST_SERVER."
+        )

+class TestRustServerPrefillReplicaDp(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_prefill_rejects_replica_dp(self):
+        """A plain-DP prefill replica's listener must not advertise a KV
+        bootstrap registry its ranks never register with."""
+
+        def args(**kwargs):
+            return ServerArgs(
+                model_path="dummy",
+                served_model_name="dummy",
+                chunked_prefill_size=-1,
+                **kwargs,
+            )
+
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_RUST_SERVER.override(True),
+            self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "prefill does not support"),
+        ):
+            args(disaggregation_mode="prefill", dp_size=2).check_server_args()
+
+        for rust_server, kwargs in (
+            (True, dict(disaggregation_mode="prefill", tp_size=2, attn_dp_size=2)),
+            (True, dict(disaggregation_mode="decode", dp_size=2)),
+            (False, dict(disaggregation_mode="prefill", dp_size=2)),
+        ):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(rust_server=rust_server, **kwargs),
+                envs.SGLANG_RUST_SERVER.override(rust_server),
+            ):
+                args(**kwargs).check_server_args()
+
